title: Sprocket's Wobbly Wheel

voice.name: Sprocket
voice.model: Veo native dialogue (veo-3.1-generate-001), isolated and re-voiced with eleven_multilingual_sts_v2

lines.note: PLAN: pushes the wheelbarrow in, the front wheel wobbles
PLAN: crouches, points at the loose bolt on the wheel hub
PLAN: spins the wheel, it rolls true, beams

signoff.note: LOCKED STANDARD: copy of audio/signoffs/signoff_sprocket.mp3 (clean studio read), fitted to the Veo tail's mouth span. NOT a voice-changed tail. Set at = main length + tail mouth onset once the tail is generated.

video.description: SPROCKET the piglet (refs/characters/sprocket_ref.png): round friendly pig, brown tool belt with a gold buckle and two brown pouches, a silver wrench in one hoof, no goggles. ONE wooden wheelbarrow with a SINGLE front wheel, in the workshop (refs/locations/workshop.png). The wheel has one visible bolt on its hub.

beats.action: Sprocket pushes the wheelbarrow into frame; its front wheel wobbles and squeaks; he looks worried and says the line.
He crouches by the wheel and points a hoof at the loose bolt on the hub, and says the line.
Silent: he fits the wrench on the bolt and turns it firmly a few times; the wheel stops wobbling and sits straight.
He gives the wheel a spin; it rolls true; he beams at the camera and says the line.

notes: Pacing standard: ~9 words + sign-off, gaps >= 0.7s, the silent tightening is the lesson beat and never shortens. Franchise: Sprocket Fixes It. Teaches: a loose part causes a wobble; tightening the bolt fixes it. Distinct from Short 4 (intro), 6 (mystery tool), 10 (doesn't belong), 14 (before-you-fix-it rule): this is a concrete fix (tighten a loose bolt). LOCKED voice standard: re-voice main once via sts; sign-off = bank signoff_sprocket.mp3 fitted to the tail (never voice-change the tail).
